healthy.en: Healthy food and exercise make a happy life.
healthy.cn: 健康饮食和锻炼让生活快乐。

habit.en: Reading before bed is a wonderful daily habit.
habit.cn: 睡前阅读是个很棒的日常习惯。

exercise.en: A little exercise in the morning gives me energy all day.
exercise.cn: 早上稍微运动一下，我一整天都有精神。

sleep.en: Children should sleep at least nine hours every night.
sleep.cn: 孩子每晚至少应睡九小时。

water.en: Try to drink eight glasses of water a day.

sweet.en: Too many sweets are not good for your teeth.

fresh.en: Open the window and breathe in the fresh morning air.
fresh.cn: 打开窗，呼吸清新的早晨空气。

strong.en: Daily exercise makes our muscles strong and healthy.
strong.cn: 每天锻炼让肌肉强壮健康。
